title: Cloud City: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Networking & Security
city_concept: City Roadway Network, Expressways, and Gated Districts

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Every bakery kitchen was built directly on the public sidewalk with no fence. Thieves walked in, and delivery trucks collided at unpainted intersections.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Rae the Dispatcher designed private gated industrial parks (VPC Networks) with designated avenue addresses (Subnets) and security checkpoints (Firewalls).

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: Two districts accidentally named their streets 'Main Street 100'. Delivery trucks refused to cross the bridge due to address collisions.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: In physical cities, bridges can cross over each other; in VPC Network Peering, overlapping subnets fail with mathematical finality.
